FR.SaveError: Friendly reminder: changes could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
FR.SendError: Friendly reminder: the message could not be sent to chat.
FR.EmptyMenu: Or right-click a chat message and choose “Save to Friendly reminder”.
FR.InvalidDrop: Drag a visible chat message from this world.
FR.ConfirmClearAll: Confirm removing every reminder from the root and all folders
FR.DragEntry: Drag this row to move the reminder to a folder or the root
FR.DeleteFolderKeep: Delete folder and move reminders to root
FR.ConfirmFolderKeep: Confirm deleting the folder and moving its reminders to root
FR.ConfirmFolderDelete: Confirm deleting the folder and all its reminders
